hooks.name: PHPCS on PHP save
hooks.description: Runs WordPress Coding Standards (PHPCS) on a saved PHP file for instant feedback. Skips silently if PHPCS is not installed yet.

action.command: cd "/Users/param/Developer/WP Multipurpose Parent Theme/wp-multipurpose-parent-theme" && if [ -x vendor/bin/phpcs ]; then FILE=$(python3 -c "import sys,json;print(json.load(sys.stdin).get('filePath',''))" 2>/dev/null); if [ -n "$FILE" ]; then vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=.phpcs.xml.dist "$FILE"; else vendor/bin/phpcs --standard=.phpcs.xml.dist; fi; else echo "PHPCS not installed yet — run 'composer install' to enable this check."; fi
